summary: Verified Dashboard KPI (نظرة عامة) truncation fix. Logged in via /mof30 with admin/Admin@12345 and tested /dashboard at 390x800, 360x740 and 1920x800. All four KPI value elements (stat-sales-month-value, stat-sales-today-value, stat-cust-debts-value, stat-pos-debts-value) render full values ('3,000', '0', '1,000', '2,000') with no clipping (scrollWidth==clientWidth, scrollHeight==clientHeight), no 'truncate' class, font-size 20px on mobile and 30px on desktop, wordBreak break-word. Desktop 4-card grid layout intact. No console errors on dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard KPI truncation fix verified across mobile (390, 360) and desktop (1920). All stat-*-value data-testids render full numbers without ellipsis/clipping.
rca of the issue: Original bug: KPI value div had 'truncate' class which set overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis, cutting off multi-digit numbers on narrow mobile columns. Fix: removed truncate, added responsive font (text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl) with break-words. Verified scrollWidth == clientWidth on all four cards at 360/390px widths.
